questions.question: What should the frozen nightside land (the old Propane Lakes, about 2,500 tiles) be called now that the lake itself is the Chill?

options.label: the Rimefall
options.description: Buys: names what falls and grows here (fuel snow, crystal rime); nothing spoiled; no clash with any label. Costs: reads a little like weather, and sits near the Fuel Snows. (Recommended: best fit for the ground itself.)

options.label: the Curtains
options.description: Buys: short, strange, beautiful; the aurora is the planet's best sky. Costs: names the sky rather than the ground.

options.label: the Dew Point
options.description: Buys: the physics that defines the place (colder than fuel liquefies). Costs: technical sounding; less like the other biome names.

options.label: the Running Flame
options.description: Buys: the blue-burning creatures are the most memorable thing here. Costs: players may expect a hot, fiery biome in the coldest land on the planet.
